notes.title: Trading Cards Released
notes.content: 3D ParticleGen VFX hast trading cards now. 8 cards , 4 profile backgrounds, 5 Badges and 5 emoticons are available now. Happy collecting!

notes.title: Release Notes and Warning!
notes.content:
We release this tool for a low price, because we find it very helpful for game developers and video post production. But we must give you a warning - to use ParticleGen, you should have at least a basic knowledge about particles, emitters, usage of keyframes and usage of transparent textures.
We highly recommend to read the manual BEFORE you purchase it!
